prompt_md: A shop offers "buy two, get one free" on 3 identical shirts. What percent discount is that off the normal price of the three shirts?
prompt_short: Buy two, get one free. Percent discount?
hint_md: You walk out with three shirts. How many did you pay for?
explain_intuition_md: You pay for two and get one free, so it feels like a half-price shirt for every full-price one. But the discount is spread over all three: one free shirt out of three is a third off.
